player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} playing a game of Checkers as {color}.
Make your move in chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (column letter a–h, row digit 0–7).
Basic rules:
  • Move diagonally forward by 1 if empty.
  • Capture by jumping over an opponent piece.
  • A piece is Kinged if it reaches the opposite end.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kāore i kitea he whakapūmau whakamātau. Whakamahia [a1b2], hei tauira [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Kāore he tākaro a te Whero. Ka wikitoria te Pango!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Kāore he tākaro i toe ki te pango. Ka wikitoria a Whero!
outcome.no_moves: Kāore he nekehanga i toe ki te kaitākaro {player_id}.
